annotations.title: Institutional RWA Clearing Take-Rate & Bridge Fee Calculator

description: Calculates institutional RWA clearing house take-rates (in basis points and USD), cross-chain settlement bridge tolls, platform SaaS subscription fees, and net annual clearing cost projections across Ariadne Nexus membership tiers. Use when: estimating monthly or annual clearing fees, basis-point take-rates, and cross-chain bridge settlement costs before syndicating an RWA vault or selecting an institutional billing tier. Do not use when: provisioning an API key or generating a live Stripe checkout session (use provision_agent_key instead), or valuing bond CUSIPs (use get_cusip_valuation instead). Behavior: Free, open-access, read-only deterministic calculator ($0.00 USD; requires no apiKey or paymentToken and performs no external network calls or billing mutations).

billing_interval.description: Subscription billing cycle used to calculate platform base fee discounts ("monthly" or "annual"; default: "monthly").

bridge_volume_usd.description: Projected monthly cross-chain bridge settlement volume (Base / Solana / Tempo USDC) in USD (e.g., 2500000 for $2.5M/month; default: 2500000).

clearing_volume_usd.description: Projected monthly gross RWA transaction volume settled through the clearing house in USD (e.g., 10000000 for $10M/month; default: 10000000).

tier.description: Institutional membership tier governing base SaaS fee and clearing take-rate bps discount (e.g., "QUANT_PRO", "INSTITUTIONAL_GOLD", "SOVEREIGN_PRIME"; default: "QUANT_PRO").

name: calculate_clearing_fee

annualizedRunRateUsd.description: Annualized 12-month total clearing and platform fee projection in USD.

baseSubscriptionUsd.description: Recurring platform subscription fee in USD.

bridgeFeeUsd.description: Monthly cross-chain bridge fee in USD.

bridgeTollBps.description: Applied cross-chain bridge settlement toll in basis points.

bridgeVolumeUsd.description: Monthly cross-chain bridge volume in USD.

clearingTakeRateBps.description: Applied clearing take-rate in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

clearingTakeRateUsd.description: Monthly clearing take-rate fee in USD.

clearingVolumeUsd.description: Monthly RWA clearing volume in USD.

totalMonthlyRevenueUsd.description: Total combined monthly platform + clearing + bridge fee in USD.

title: Institutional RWA Clearing Take-Rate & Bridge Fee Calculator
